frontendGitSource.method: Native index.html and both entry response bodies match the account-build identity SHA-256; entry URLs also match.

provenance.meaning: Actual anonymous production AFTER evidence captured only after the root release-finished signal. Distinct from earlier staging acceptance.

method: Native public network responses and original screenshot bytes. No route fulfillment, storage seeding, account creation, login, auth submission, email or member-data mutation. GET/HEAD/OPTIONS only; other methods blocked before dispatch. Library cards scrolled into view before 24 thumbnail decodes; loaded fonts, background photos, focus, auth transitions, document and auth-panel containment checked.

safety.networkBoundary: Only the exact public production origin could dispatch; foreign requests and cross-origin redirects were blocked. No protected staging state was read or attached.

observations.finding: The 320px signup supporting copy is clearly separate from the emblem. Desktop Overview photos and layout are coherent. The full-page Library capture and all 24 decoded thumbnails support structural/media verification; its resized preview is not a fine-detail review of every thumbnail.
observations.liveGeometry: All six loaded-font widths 320, 360, 375, 390, 430 and 540 pass with full copy, zero line/emblem intersections and no clipped controls.

limitations: Anonymous functional/media/focus smoke, not account sign-in or member mutation testing.
No new axe scan, manual assistive-technology, physical Safari, performance or blanket accessibility-conformance claim.
PNG dimensions are read from IHDR and all bytes verified against original capture hashes; this is not exercise-pose or licensing approval.
Matched production comparison uses actual capture times, routes and viewport widths. A changed PNG hash is not by itself a visual regression; no dates or pixels were normalized.
